_from: The fictional job seekers of the owner's profile round (12 Nov 2026: b01-b10, c01-c20; 13 Nov 2026: d01-d07 for the Trello board only, not in the benchmark round): one role, one city each. Fictional people only; the CV comes from draws.json (draw.cv), or from the row's own duty/education/tools when its role is not a family there (draws.json is never extended: it would move the seeded draws and the night people). Read by tools/persona-search/profiles.py and .github/workflows/search-profiles.yml; never by the nightly Search check (gate-personas.json, locked by scoreboard.lock.json). eures = the profile's EURES count X from the Mac round (12 Nov 2026, the round's baseline.json): a row meets its target when N >= X; X = 0 is not measured, never a pass (sa, 13 Nov 2026); the d rows have no EURES target, so they are not measured. A row with an `area` (the places it is willing to work in, d05-d07) has it in its CV and in the judge's title (profiles.for_judge); the home city is where the judge says it lives (d06 Zurich: sa's choice, to change on the owner's word).

profiles.tools: Digital tachograph, handheld scanner, route planning, load securing
